description: NaNb₂Si₂PO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.59-2.67 Å. There are two inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.06 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.11 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-33°. There are two shorter (1.63 Å) and two longer (1.64 Å) Si-O bond lengths. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-34°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.65 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-32°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.56 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Nb and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Nb and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Nb and one Si atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Nb and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Nb and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Nb and one Si atom.
